F81 has the lowest BIC. I fitted it as F81+F, meaning base frequencies are estimated from the data. That matters because IQ-TREE's bare "F81" uses equal frequencies, which makes it the same as JC69.

| Model | BIC | ΔBIC |
|---|---|---|
| F81 (F81+F) | 21644.97 | 0 |
| HKY85 (HKY+F) | 21649.37 | 4.40 |
| K80 | 21833.13 | 188.16 |
| JC69 | 21836.27 | 191.30 |

Estimating unequal base frequencies improves the fit a lot. HKY85's extra transition/transversion parameter raises the log-likelihood by only about 1.3, which is not enough to cover BIC's penalty for one more parameter. AIC and AICc would pick HKY85 instead, so the answer depends on using BIC.

ANSWER: F81
